what: M42, also known as the Orion Nebula, is a diffuse nebula situated in the Milky Way, notable for being a stellar nursery where new stars are forming within a large cloud of gas and dust.
distance: It is approximately 1,344 light-years away from Earth.
when_image_taken: The JWST MIRI observation of M42 was taken during JWST Cycle 1.
